button-disabled:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button [disabled]="true">禁用按钮</t-button>
  <t-button [disabled]="true" theme="primary">禁用按钮</t-button>
  <t-button [loading]="true" theme="primary">加载中</t-button>
  <t-button [loading]="true" variant="outline">加载中</t-button>
</t-space>
button-ghost:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button [ghost]="true" variant="outline">幽灵按钮</t-button>
  <t-button [ghost]="true" variant="base" theme="primary">幽灵按钮</t-button>
</t-space>
button-icon:
<t-space [breakLine]="true" align="center">
  <t-button theme="primary"><t-icon name="add" tButtonIcon />新建</t-button>
  <t-button variant="outline">下载<t-icon name="download" tButtonSuffix /></t-button>
  <t-button shape="square" theme="primary"><t-icon name="search" tButtonIcon /></t-button>
</t-space>
button-link:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button href="https://tdesign.tencent.com/" target="_blank" variant="text" theme="primary">跳转链接</t-button>
  <t-button tag="div" variant="outline">div 按钮</t-button>
</t-space>
button-shape:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button shape="rectangle" theme="primary">矩形按钮</t-button>
  <t-button shape="square" theme="primary">方</t-button>
  <t-button shape="round" theme="primary">圆角按钮</t-button>
  <t-button shape="circle" theme="primary">圆</t-button>
</t-space>
button-size:
<t-space align="center" [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button size="small" theme="primary">小尺寸</t-button>
  <t-button size="medium" theme="primary">中尺寸</t-button>
  <t-button size="large" theme="primary">大尺寸</t-button>
</t-space>
button-theme:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button theme="default">默认</t-button>
  <t-button theme="primary">主要</t-button>
  <t-button theme="danger">危险</t-button>
  <t-button theme="warning">警告</t-button>
  <t-button theme="success">成功</t-button>
</t-space>
button-variant:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-button variant="base" theme="default">基础按钮</t-button>
  <t-button variant="outline" theme="default">描边按钮</t-button>
  <t-button variant="dashed" theme="default">虚线按钮</t-button>
  <t-button variant="text" theme="default">文本按钮</t-button>
</t-space>
divider-align:
<t-divider align="left">左侧文字</t-divider>
<t-divider align="center">居中文字</t-divider>
<t-divider align="right">右侧文字</t-divider>
divider-horizontal:
通过设置内容区块的分割线，让结构更清晰。

使用虚线分割线。

分割线可以带文字。

input-basic: 当前值：{{ value || '（空）' }}
input-clearable: 当前值：{{ value || '（空）' }}
input-icon:
<t-input placeholder="搜索" [(value)]="value">
  <t-icon tInputPrefixIcon name="search" />
</t-input>
<t-input placeholder="请输入用户名">
  <t-icon tInputSuffixIcon name="user" />
</t-input>
input-label: 姓名：{{ value || '（空）' }}
input-limit:
<t-space [breakLine]="true" [size]="16">
  <t-input placeholder="最多 10 个字符" [maxcharacter]="10" [showLimitNumber]="true" [(value)]="short" />
  <t-input placeholder="最多 6 个字符（npm 输入会截断）" [maxcharacter]="6" [showLimitNumber]="true" />
</t-space>
input-size:
<t-space [breakLine]="true" [size]="16">
  <t-input size="small" placeholder="小尺寸" />
  <t-input size="medium" placeholder="中尺寸（默认）" />
  <t-input size="large" placeholder="大尺寸" />
</t-space>
input-state:
<t-space [breakLine]="true" [size]="16">
  <t-input placeholder="禁用状态" value="不可编辑" [disabled]="true" />
  <t-input placeholder="只读状态" value="只读内容" [readonly]="true" />
  <t-input placeholder="无边框" value="无边框输入框" [borderless]="true" />
</t-space>
input-status:
<t-space [breakLine]="true" [size]="16">
  <t-input status="success" tips="校验通过" value="TDesign" />
  <t-input status="warning" tips="这个用户名不太常见" value="tdesign-ng" />
  <t-input status="error" tips="该用户名已被占用" value="admin" />
</t-space>
link-base:
<t-space [breakLine]="true">
  <t-link href="#basic">默认链接</t-link>

  <t-link href="#basic" theme="danger">危险链接</t-link>
  <t-link href="#basic" theme="warning">警告链接</t-link>
  <t-link href="#basic" theme="success">成功链接</t-link>
</t-space>
link-disabled:

</t-space>
link-icon:

link-size:

</t-space>
link-underline:
